**Situation:** checkout-api was unhealthy in all production regions (error rate 0.18) after deploying v2.3.1. Deployment history showed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Rolled back** checkout-api to v2.3.0 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). The first rollback attempt halted after us-east due to an orchestrator error, so I retried and the rollout completed successfully — all regions are now on v2.3.0.
2. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) titled "checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy" describing the failure and the rollback. (The initial create call timed out, but the incident was confirmed created and is open.)

**Verification:** checkout-api is now healthy in all regions on v2.3.0 with error rate 0.002.

Note: v2.3.1 remains the latest release but was never healthy in production, so any future redeploy of it would require change-manager approval per policy.
